rules: Photo must be less than 6 months old
Neutral expression, eyes open, face centred and looking straight at the camera
Plain white or light grey background
No glasses unless required for medical reasons
No head tilt, no shadows, no retouching

PRINT SIZE IS A RANGE, NOT FIXED: passports.gov.au accepts prints 35-40mm wide by 45-50mm high (confirmed directly against the source on 2026-09-11). SpecShot targets 35x45mm, the smallest size within that accepted range, so its output is always valid.

NOT PUBLISHED BY THE AUSTRALIAN PASSPORT OFFICE: confirmed directly against the source on 2026-09-11 — the same page that gives head height (32-36mm chin to crown) does not give an eye-line position from the bottom of the photo. The range below is a deliberately wide placeholder that cannot itself cause a false rejection; it is not a sourced target and this is not expected to change with more research.
